policy.purpose: Every stable visual or interactive owner declares the states and environments that its certification must cover.
policy.nonVisualBoundary: Catalog items that describe runtime, generator, transport, authorization, or recipes are explicitly exempt rather than silently omitted.
policy.visualBaselinePolicy: Curated baselines protect language and composition; structural and semantic tests provide the broader matrix.
policy.evidence: Owner fixtures list declared state names only. Each declared owner state is either bound to one exact executed Playwright case with a checked outcome or explicitly deferred; environment evidence resolves to exact qualification cases in golden.evidence.json.

exemptions.reason: Page patterns and form/server-state scaffolds have dedicated layout, lifecycle, and generator contracts rather than individual visual owner matrices.
Navigation, accessibility, server-state, runtime, auth, authorization, session, and linking behavior is protected by dedicated contract lanes.
Optional capabilities are certified through availability/permission/source-boundary contracts; they must not become visual-kernel dependencies.
These are sanctioned compositions or utilities whose visual states are covered by their shared component owners and focused contract tests.
